$comment: Descriptors an implementation must accept or reject before it renders anything. The error category is informative; only valid is compared.

tests.description: a $schema whose MAJOR version the wallet does not implement makes the descriptor invalid

spec.quote: A wallet MUST consider a descriptor invalid if the MAJOR version identified by its $schema key is not one the wallet implements, since a MAJOR version bump signals a breaking change to the schema.

tests.description: a $schema that points at the alias file of an implemented MAJOR line is valid

spec.section: Versioning > Schema files and the $schema key
spec.quote: A descriptor MAY point at an alias file, in which case it is validated against the newest release of that MAJOR line, or at an exact-version file, in which case it pins that exact version.

tests.description: a $schema that points at an exact-version file of an implemented MAJOR line is valid

spec.section: Versioning > Schema files and the $schema key
spec.quote: A descriptor MAY point at an alias file, in which case it is validated against the newest release of that MAJOR line, or at an exact-version file, in which case it pins that exact version.

tests.description: two format keys with the same type-only signature make the descriptor invalid

spec.quote: If multiple keys share the same type-only signature, wallets MUST treat this as an invalid descriptor.

tests.description: a format key that uses the uint alias is invalid

spec.quote: Aliases (e.g., uint) are NOT permitted, commas MUST NOT be followed by spaces, and there MUST be exactly one space between each type and its parameter name.

tests.description: a format key with a space after a comma is invalid

spec.quote: Aliases (e.g., uint) are NOT permitted, commas MUST NOT be followed by spaces, and there MUST be exactly one space between each type and its parameter name.

tests.description: a format name that the spec does not define is invalid

spec.quote: Indicates how the field value must be transformed for display. Supported format identifiers are listed in the Reference section.

tests.description: an enum $ref that points at no enum is invalid

spec.quote: $ref: An internal path (starting with root node $.) to an enumerations in metadata.enums

tests.description: a field $ref that points at no definition is invalid

spec.quote: A reference to a format specification in the definitions section: by declaring an object with two keys, a path key with the path to the field being formatted, and a $ref key with a path to the internal definition.

tests.description: an includes URL that cannot be resolved makes the descriptor invalid

spec.quote: The includes top-level key is a URL pointing to an ERC-7730 file that MUST follow this specification.
